---
name: Game compatibility report
about: Tell us how a game runs (or does not) on Uncork
title: "[Game] "
labels: compatibility
---

**Game**
Name, store, and ID (Steam appid, or the title for Epic/GOG).

**Your Mac**
Chip (M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 / M5, Pro/Max/Ultra) and macOS version.

**Result**
- [ ] Works
- [ ] Launches but has problems
- [ ] Does not start

**What happens**
Describe it. If it stops somewhere (black screen, crash, error dialog), say where and
quote any error text exactly.

**Settings you used**
Backend (Auto / D3DMetal / DXMT), any launch options, Windows version, and whether
Fullscreen (safe) was on.

**Launch log**
Open the game's page, choose **View launch log**, and paste the relevant part here
(especially the last lines before it stopped).

```
paste log here
```
